tagline: Provider docs, module search, and Checkov scans for remote teammates — terraform runs need your approval.
requirements: No credentials needed for documentation search and Checkov scans (public registry and local files). This is the official AWS Labs server for AWS-focused Terraform and Terragrunt workflows; command execution stays off by default.

tools.name: search_awscc_provider_docs
tools.note: Searches AWS Cloud Control provider docs.

tools.name: run_checkov_scan
tools.note: Scans local Terraform files with Checkov.

tools.name: execute_terraform_command
tools.note: Runs terraform init/plan/apply on the host — apply changes real infrastructure.

tools.name: execute_terragrunt_command
tools.note: Runs terragrunt commands on the host.

seo.description: Share the official Terraform MCP server with MCPWire. Let teammates search provider docs and scan configurations over P2P, and keep terraform apply behind approval.
